ctaHeading: Ready to Build in Thornbury? Let's Talk.
aboutText: Pat, the owner of Home Builders Melbourne Inner North, brings over 25 years of hands-on building experience to Thornbury. His team specialises in custom-built new homes, knockdown rebuilds, and smart home designs for challenging sloping blocks in Melbourne's Inner North. With a focus on clear communication and excellent craftsmanship, they ensure every project from dual living to double story builds is tailored to your needs.
servicesText: Our team in Thornbury provides comprehensive building services, from custom new homes to intelligent designs for sloping blocks. We handle knockdown rebuilds, dual living constructions, and double story builds with precision and local expertise.

services.title: Custom Built New Homes

services.title: Smart Home Designs for Sloping Blocks
